settings.title: Everything your pipeline
settings.intro: ForgeKit replaces the patchwork of build servers, test runners, and monitoring dashboards with one coherent toolchain. Here's what's inside.

features.title: Instant CI/CD
features.text: Push a branch and watch it build, test, and deploy in minutes. Parallel pipelines and smart caching mean your queue never becomes the bottleneck.

features.title: Live observability
features.text: Traces, logs, and metrics in a single view. When something breaks, you see the exact commit and the exact line — not a wall of guesswork.

features.title: Preview environments
features.text: Every pull request gets its own live URL. Review real UI, not screenshots, and merge with confidence that what you saw is what ships.

features.title: Secrets & config
features.text: Encrypted secrets, environment variables, and feature flags managed in one place — with audit logs and per-team access controls.

features.title: Deploy to anything
features.text: One-click deploys to AWS, GCP, Azure, Vercel, or your own servers. Rollbacks are instant and every deploy is fully reversible.

features.title: Team workflows
features.text: Code review, approvals, and status checks wired into your git flow. Enforce your process without slowing your people down.

settings.title: From first commit
settings.intro: Whether you're a two-person startup or a platform team at a hundred engineers, ForgeKit grows with you. Here's how teams typically start.

design.title: Free tier for side projects
design.text: Unlimited private repos, 2,000 build minutes, and full observability — free forever for small projects. No credit card required to start.

design.title: Quickstart templates
design.text: Spin up a working pipeline for Node, Python, Go, or Rust in minutes with battle-tested templates. Your first deploy is an afternoon away.

build.title: Team plans
build.text: Unlimited build minutes, preview environments, and granular permissions. Add seats as you grow — pricing scales with your team, not your anxiety.

build.title: Advanced caching
build.text: Smart dependency caching cuts build times by up to 70%. Your CI stops being the thing everyone waits on.

launch.title: Enterprise security
launch.text: SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, audit logs, and dedicated support. Compliance-ready from day one with SOC 2 and GDPR coverage.

launch.title: Self-hosted option
launch.text: Run ForgeKit inside your own VPC for air-gapped or regulated environments. Same experience, your infrastructure.

settings.title: From signup to shipping
settings.intro: ForgeKit is designed to be adopted in an afternoon, not a quarter. Here's the path from first login to a live pipeline.

steps.title: Connect your repos
steps.text: Link your GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket account. ForgeKit imports your projects and detects your stack automatically.

steps.title: Pick a template
steps.text: Choose a starter pipeline for your language and framework. It just works — no YAML archaeology required.

steps.title: Push and watch it build
steps.text: Your first build runs in minutes. Add tests, preview environments, and deploy targets as you go.

steps.title: Ship with confidence
steps.text: Every merge is tested, reviewed, and deployable. Your team ships faster, and you finally see the whole pipeline in one place.

settings.note: Most teams go from signup to their first production deploy in under an hour. If you get stuck, our docs and community have you covered — and real humans answer support.

settings.title: Questions teams
settings.intro: Straight answers about pricing, migration, and what makes ForgeKit different.

items.question: How hard is it to migrate from our current CI?
items.answer: Most teams migrate in a day. We import your repos, detect your stack, and generate a working pipeline from templates. You can run ForgeKit alongside your existing tooling until you're ready to switch fully.

items.question: Do you support our language and framework?
items.answer: We have first-class templates for Node, Python, Go, Rust, Java, and Ruby, plus Docker-based builds for anything else. If your stack runs in a container, it runs on ForgeKit.

items.question: What happens if we exceed our build minutes?
items.answer: Builds pause gracefully and resume when your quota resets — nothing is lost. On paid plans you can add burst minutes or move to unlimited. We never surprise you with overage charges.

items.question: Is our code and data secure?
items.answer: Yes. ForgeKit is SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant. Secrets are encrypted at rest and in transit, and enterprise plans add SSO, SCIM, and audit logs. You can also self-host entirely within your own VPC.

items.question: Can we try it before paying?
items.answer: Absolutely. The free tier includes unlimited private repos, 2,000 build minutes, and full observability — no credit card required. Upgrade only when you need more.
